name: labby
description: Claude Code client integration for the Labby MCP gateway.

server_url.title: Labby server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Labby MCP HTTP server this Claude Code client should connect to. Do not include a trailing /mcp; the plugin appends it.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Optional bearer token for this client connection when the selected Labby endpoint uses bearer authentication.
